Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: clean educational state diagram for an operating systems lecture, landscape 3:2 on ivory background. Draw exactly three large simple circles aligned triangle: upper left labeled 'READY', upper right 'RUNNING', bottom center 'WAITING'. Dark navy lettering, muted teal ready, warm orange running, gray blue waiting. Exactly five straight directional arrows with small labels: READY to RUNNING labeled 'dispatch'; RUNNING to READY labeled 'preempt'; RUNNING to WAITING labeled 'block'; WAITING to READY labeled 'event'. READY to RUNNING and reverse should be visually separated two distinct horizontal arrows. NO WAITING to RUNNING arrow. The fifth instruction is not fifth arrow: total exactly FOUR arrows. No people, icons, textures or extra text. Elegant legible textbook schematic, generous spacing. Model excludes new and terminated states.

Outside but near bottom of right container two small labels 'T1: PC + registers' and 'T2: PC + registers'. Label left side heading 'Separate address spaces', right side heading 'Shared address space'. Minimal navy, teal and orange textbook diagram. No arrows between address spaces. Stacks T1/T2 both INSIDE same process R container, not protection boundaries. No chefs, no kitchen.
